<thought>From the 13C NMR data, only one carbon signal appears in the typical methyl region (≈10‑30 ppm), at 26.41 ppm. The other low‑field signals (36‑38 ppm) are likely methylene or quaternary carbons, not methyls. Therefore the molecule contains a single methyl group.</thought>
